'''Ditty''' (Japanese: '''メタちゃん''' ''Meta-chan'') is a {{p|Ditto}} that {{adv|Green}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and her fifth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. It is at [[level]] 60 and its [[Characteristic]] is that it is "mischievous."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}===
[[File:Green and Ditty.png|thumb|left|150px|Ditty and Green]]
Ditty first appeared in ''[[PS016|Tauros the Tyrant]]''. {{adv|Green}} substituted it for [[Blasty]] during the battle with [[Team Rocket]] in [[Celadon City]] when Blasty was trampled by their {{p|Hitmonlee}} and [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s {{p|Machamp}}. As soon as Ditty was sent out, Team Rocket became amused by it as they found it to be weak. Ken then sends out his {{p|Tauros}} in order to knock Ditty and Green out. However, {{adv|Red}} came to Green's rescue but unfortunately, Ditty fell off the cliff. Ditty, however, {{m|Transform|transformed}} into Ken's Tauros which also fell off the cliff. As Ditty transformed into Tauros it took control of Team Rocket's Pokémon and forced them to attack their {{pkmn|Trainer}}s, allowing Green and Red to get away. After Green revealed that she gave Team Rocket the fake disc and that she had the real one, she sent out Ditty again to take on the form of a {{p|Mew}} in order to keep Ken and Team Rocket occupied. With Ditty distracting them, both Red and Green go off to search for {{adv|Mew}}. However, Ken managed to weaken Ditty using {{p|Jynx}} before the two Trainers were able to capture the real Mew.

In ''[[PS030|Zap! Zap! Zapdos!]]'', Ditty, disguised as Blasty, was sent out to battle [[Sabrina's Kadabra]] when the {{type|Psychic}} created an illusion of a giant tower outside of the one Green was in. Unfortunately, {{p|Kadabra}} was too quick for Ditty as it used {{m|Teleport}} to dodge and knocked it down with {{m|Psychic}}. With Ditty immobilized, Kadabra was about to finish it off until Green revealed that the Blastoise [[Sabrina]] was fighting was merely a transformation coming from her Ditty. Blasty was then sent out and defeated Kadabra.

==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}===
In ''[[PS084|Clefabulous Clefable]]'', Ditty disguised itself as Green's right hand when she was fighting against [[Lorelei]], tricking her into believing she had bound Green and Sabrina together. Ditty later fell off, making [[Lorelei]] believe that Green's hand had been destroyed with the destruction of her {{m|Ice Beam|ice doll}}. However, Ditty soon turns back to normal and wrapped up Lorelei and her Jynx, immobilizing them.
[[File:Ditty Transformed as Deoxys.png|thumb|150px|Ditty transformed as Deoxys]]
==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===
In ''[[PS162|Heckled by Hitmontop]]'', Ditty disguised Green from {{adv|Silver}} so she could get close enough to Teleport him with her {{p|Abra}}.

==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===
In ''[[PS270|Now You See Me...]]'', Jiggly battled {{adv|Deoxys|Organism No. 1}} alongside the rest of Green's team. Due to the DNA Pokémon's speed and invisibility Green's Pokémon are quickly overwhelmed. Red and {{adv|Blue}} later come to save her and bring her to the [[Pokémon Network Center]]. [[PS272|After]] the two of them leave to go to [[Two Island]] Ditty sneaks into Red's backpack. While the two went off to train Ditty became friends with [[Ultima]] and filled her in on the situation by using Transform to communicate. [[PS274|When]] Red and Blue finished their training Ditty was waiting for them Transformed as {{p|Deoxys}}, allowing the two to get an understanding of what they were fighting.

In ''[[PS302|Phew for Mew]]'', Ditty and Green found themselves petrified by [[Sird]], along with the four other [[Pokédex holder]]s and their Pokémon.

==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===
In ''[[PS334|The Final Battle VII]]'', Ditty appeared alongside the rest of Green's team when she was checking to make sure they all survived the petrification caused by {{adv|Mewtwo}} and {{p|Darkrai}}. In ''[[PS337|Epilogue]]'', Ditty interacted with [[Vee]] in the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|III}} following [[Guile Hideout]]'s defeat.

==Personality and characteristics==
Ditty is a very happy-go-lucky {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, and is often seen enjoying whatever it is doing. Ditty tends to not get serious until there is a threat to its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, and then becomes very concerned and stoic. Because Ditty's only move is {{m|Transform}}, Green does not use it in battle very often, instead using it to help trick people. Besides transforming into other Pokémon, Ditty can also change into {{cat|items}}, as well as a facial mask to help Green disguise herself as someone else, such as [[Sabrina]].
